title: Chapter 1482 - 607: Growing Stronger Through Battle
content:
Chapter 1482: Chapter 607: Growing Stronger Through Battle

"Ning Zhuo, prepare to be defeated by me!" Flowing Gold Guest’s shout was like a bell struck by metal, causing ripples to spread through the air.

He charged in like a mass of flames forged with golden blood!

His arms were covered with armor, sharp blades sprouted from his fingertips, and the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo in his chest throbbed intensely. The gold and red glow shone through his flesh, flickering ominously, exuding a non-human aura.

At this moment, the sharpness of his Golden Core Level Body Cultivation was fully revealed!

The golden blade tore through the air, its piercing whistle like tearing silk, aiming straight for Ning Zhuo’s chest and abdomen.

Cao Gui’s face turned pale, and Jiang Xiaobian was so tense that she lost her color.

Situ Xing’s eyes narrowed as he stared at Ning Zhuo, thinking to himself, "Will he reveal his trump card and release that Golden Core Level Puppet?"

Ning Zhuo sat calmly atop the Green Forest Python Chariot. Though there was gravity in his eyes, there was no panic.

The Great Thousand Mechanism Sound Robe on him suddenly illuminated with a faint layer of silver patterns.

Usually, this vestment robe appeared elegant with its flowing Cloud Thunder Cyan Pattern. However, at this moment, as Flowing Gold Guest approached, the silver threads on the robe were like countless tiny strings being plucked by an invisible mechanism sound.

Buzz...

A soft hum emerged from deep within Ning Zhuo’s robe.

The sound wasn’t loud, yet it was extraordinarily strange. It wasn’t like a zither, not like a bell, not like a drum, but more like hundreds of tiny mechanisms simultaneously activated — gears meshing, springs vibrating, copper axles swirling. Thousands of subtle sounds converged into a faint and intricate mechanical melody.

Flowing Gold Guest’s golden blade had already reached three feet in front of Ning Zhuo.

But at that moment, the blade suddenly veered off course.

It wasn’t because Flowing Gold Guest’s hand faltered, but due to the sound waves emitted by the Great Thousand Mechanism Sound Robe at such close range, disrupting the flow path of his golden blood within, and breaking his rhythm.

Although the Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body was indeed formidable, with golden blood acting as mana and golden blood as the flesh. Every move of Flowing Gold Guest was tightly linked to the flow of golden blood within him. But precisely because of this, when the sound waves disturbed him closely, affecting his blood flow and other minute rhythms, it exerted an influence that accumulated over time, eventually interfering with his entire action.

Flowing Gold Guest’s pupils contracted slightly.

"The Great Thousand Mechanism Sound Robe!" Naturally, he knew of the Empty Valley Sound Green Mechanism Tube’s intelligence heritage.

Therefore, without hesitation, Flowing Gold Guest swung his other hand’s golden blade, forcibly cutting through the layer of sound wave disturbance.

Ning Zhuo seized the brief moment, controlling the Green Forest Python Chariot to retreat abruptly.

However, with the Thousand Weight Plunge imposing in the arena, the earth power weighed heavy, and the Mystic Wheel under the Mechanical Chariot emitted a dull scraping sound, retreating far slower than usual.

Flowing Gold Guest sneered coldly, "Can you evade it?"

The Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo in his chest pulsed again, the Blood Gold Essence Liquid reinvigorating his entire body, quickly smoothing out the blood rhythm disrupted by the sound waves.

He stamped heavily on the ground, crunch, the black stone bricks cracked, and his entire figure dragged a fierce afterimage in the air as he closed in on Ning Zhuo again.

Ning Zhuo raised his right hand, and four wooden boxes flew out from the Storage Waist Belt.

The wooden boxes simultaneously opened.

Four pieces of Mysterious Armor: sword, axe, hook, and dagger burst out of the boxes!

Clang!

Clang clang!

The sounds of clashing burst continuously, as though an armory had been opened, revealing cold, sharp weapons.

The large blade radiated a senile white sharpness, tracing an arc of light as it flew out. The longsword exuded cold intent, sword light fine like a star’s line. The massive axe was as heavy as a mountain, pressing the air taut upon its appearance. The short hook was sinister and bizarre, its curved edge turning like cold teeth under the moon, seeking the enemy’s vulnerability.

All four pieces of Mysterious Armor were of Golden Core Level, gifted by the Armor Cave as prestigious gifts. At this moment, they suppressed the Martial Arts Arena with the might of Golden Core-level Treasures, standing firmly in front of Ning Zhuo.

Flowing Gold Guest punched the axe soldier.

Boom!

Golden light collided with Mystic Cyan Axe shadow, the blast of air waves forced the Green Forest Python Chariot to slide back several zhang.

The axe soldier was knocked flying, a golden dent appearing on the axe surface. Flowing Gold Guest’s arms tingled slightly, countless sparks bursting from the surface of the golden armor.

His eyes filled with more ferocity: "Mere Mysterious Armor can stop me?!"

Ning Zhuo did not respond, altering his hand formula.

The four pieces of Mysterious Armor did not fight individually; instead, they began revolving around Ning Zhuo.

The blade took the lead, the sword flanking, the axe in the rear, the hook lurking at an oblique angle. The four intertwined Qi mechanisms, the cold shaft reciprocated, forming a frigid ring of soldiers.

But that was not all.

Ning Zhuo released several old Mysterious Armors.

Among them, the one shaped like a human leg was the Mysterious Armor·Old Cold Leg. As this leg emerged, frost took shape instantly, covering the leg armor’s surface with fine ice patterns, joints creaking as if a frozen-bone warrior were loosening its joints.

Additionally, several pieces like fists, shields, and short blades flew out, each taking its position.

Situ Xing’s eyes flashed with a peculiar gleam, "Defensive Stupidity Rotation Array!"

Ning Zhuo devised this formation during the Xingyun Trial of Qingwu Langjun, under the gaze of everyone, thus widely known.

The Defensive Wheel Slash Formation emphasizes attack-defense rotation and suspended soldiers’ flexibility.

Using four Golden Core level Mysterious Armors as the main axle and supporting with the Old Cold Leg and other old Mysterious Armors, forming inner and outer soldier wheels around Ning Zhuo.

Sword, axe, hook, dagger mainly for slaughter.

Fist, shield, leg, blade mainly for reception.

Once the formation was established, it seemed as if an invisible array line linked the Mysterious Armors. For Flowing Gold Guest to approach Ning Zhuo again, he would need to pass through this vortex of cold light composed of Golden Core Treasures and the killing intent of Mysterious Armors.

"Come!" Flowing Gold Guest shouted angrily.

The Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo in his chest throbbed fiercely, his skin covered a few degrees thicker by golden blood. He rotated both fists, golden light surging like a tide, crashing directly into the Defensive Stupidity Rotation Array.

In an instant, the Martial Arts Arena echoed with a dense roar almost blending into one.

Clang clang clang clang clang!

Sword armor slashed horizontally, being deflected by Flowing Gold Guest’s arm, a white mark splitting on the golden armor.

Sword soldiers attacked obliquely, sword light like a cold star, targeting beneath Flowing Gold Guest’s rib, which was hard-blocked by the golden shield condensed in his palm.
